# Monitoring dashboard tracking and local startup

**Status:** dev

Source review of server.js, dashboard.html and both shell scripts in monitoring/. No local run of the dashboard or the anomaly script was performed; runtime behavior claims follow from the code paths read.; verified against sources 2026-09-14 (author pass)

<!-- wiki:enrich id=monitoring-dashboard fp=6cc528201b58f0e4894ad600fa1e8cd1b1d07d1b44cb80da44aa49e76efa9f98 -->
## Purpose

Start it with `bash monitoring/start-dashboard.sh` run FROM the monitoring/ directory (it exits 1 elsewhere): the script verifies Node >= 16, runs npm install when node_modules is missing, warns without failing when Docker is down or Redis at localhost:6379 is unreachable, then runs npm start (pass --dev for nodemon auto-reload). The Express server (PORT env or 5555) serves dashboard.html at / and JSON under /api/*. The dashboard tracks: CFN-related Docker containers (names matching cfn/redis/cadvisor/consensus/agent-comm; total/running/failed counts plus per-container cpu/memory/network via /api/containers/:name/stats), host memory and load read from /proc/meminfo and /proc/loadavg, CFN loop task status (active/completed/failed, avg confidence) parsed from Redis keys cfn_loop:*:context:, agent health (a ps-aux count of 'claude-flow-novice agent' processes), agent rows from the SQLite DB at ../claude-assets/skills/cfn-redis-coordination/data/cfn-loop.db (SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY spawned_at DESC), and Redis swarm:* signals. The page calls refreshData() on load and every 10 s (setInterval(refreshData, 10000)). Failure path: if Redis is down /api/cfn returns all-zero defaults and the SQLite/Redis cards show 0 and 'Disconnected', but the container/system/cfn cards silently fall back to hardcoded demo mock data ('Simulate API calls with mock data for demo'), so on-screen numbers may not be live; a thrown refresh error is logged to the Recent Logs panel and raises the alert bar. cost-anomaly-detection.sh is a standalone companion (not wired into the server): per team it compares the last-1h rate of Prometheus metric zai_api_cost_usd against the same window offset 24h back and POSTs a webhook alert plus pushgateway gauge when the ratio exceeds ANOMALY_THRESHOLD (default 1.20); modes are detect (default), health (Prometheus reachability + metric count) and test (10% threshold).

## Evidence

Reviewed: 2026-09-14

- `monitoring/start-dashboard.sh:34`: Startup contract: must be run from the monitoring/ directory (checks package.json and server.js exist, exits 1 otherwise); verifies Node >= 16 via sort -V; npm-installs when node_modules is absent; only WARNS (no exit) when docker info fails or redis-cli ping to localhost:6379 fails, noting 'CFN metrics will show default values'; finally runs npm run dev under --dev (nodemon) else npm start.
- `monitoring/server.js:8`: Express app on PORT env or 5555; Redis client hardcoded to redis://localhost:6379; opens SQLite DB at ../claude-assets/skills/cfn-redis-coordination/data/cfn-loop.db via initializeSQLite() at startup (non-fatal on error, logged via .catch(console.error)).
- `monitoring/server.js:94`: GET /api/containers lists all Docker containers and filters to CFN-related names (cfn, redis, cadvisor, consensus, agent-comm), returning total/running/failed plus per-container name/status/memory/image/ports; list-level cpu is always 'N/A'; 500 on Docker error. GET /api/containers/:name/stats (line 233) returns real cpu_usage, memory usage/limit and summed network rx/tx from the Docker stats API.
- `monitoring/server.js:137`: GET /api/system reads /proc/meminfo and /proc/loadavg through a bash spawn helper and returns memoryTotal, memoryUsed and the 1-minute load.
- `monitoring/server.js:162`: GET /api/cfn scans Redis keys cfn_loop:* and parses *:context:* values into activeTasks/completedTasks/failedTasks and avgConfidence; healthyAgents comes from `ps aux | grep 'claude-flow-novice agent' | wc -l`; memoryAlerts is hardcoded 0 ('Would need telemetry integration'). Failure path: on any Redis error the route returns an all-zero default payload instead of a 500, so the dashboard shows zeros rather than an error when Redis is down.
- `monitoring/server.js:255`: GET /api/agents queries the SQLite agents table (SELECT * FROM agents ORDER BY spawned_at DESC), 500ing when the DB never initialized; GET /api/redis/signals (line 290) lists swarm:* keys with values, emitting per-key error entries rather than aborting; GET /api/health (line 336) reports status/uptime; GET / (line 345) serves dashboard.html; SIGINT closes Redis and SQLite gracefully.
- `monitoring/dashboard.html:243`: The page ('CFN Docker Monitoring Dashboard', title at line 6) renders cards for System Overview (total/running/failed containers, system load), Memory Usage (with progress bar), CFN Loop Status (active/completed/failed tasks, avg confidence), Agent Health (healthy/stuck agents, memory alerts, timeout rate), CFN Agents from SQLite (line 325), Redis Swarm Signals (line 341), plus a Container Status list (line 359) and a Recent Logs panel (line 369); a status bar shows system status, last-update time and a manual Refresh button wired to refreshData().
- `monitoring/dashboard.html:382`: Five fetchers poll the server APIs (/api/containers, /api/system, /api/cfn, /api/agents, /api/redis/signals), each returning null on fetch failure instead of throwing.
- `monitoring/dashboard.html:516`: refreshData() failure path is asymmetric: container/system/cfn stats fall back to hardcoded demo mock data under the comment 'Simulate API calls with mock data for demo' (fake containers like cfn-orchestrator, 16GB/8.5GB memory), so those cards keep showing plausible-but-fake numbers when the APIs are down; the SQLite and Redis cards instead show 0 and 'Disconnected'.
- `monitoring/dashboard.html:654`: Init and scheduling: refreshData() runs once at script load, then setInterval(refreshData, 10000) auto-refreshes every 10 seconds; a thrown error inside refreshData logs 'Failed to refresh dashboard data' to the Recent Logs panel (capped at 50 entries) and shows the alert bar via showAlert().
- `monitoring/cost-anomaly-detection.sh:9`: Standalone companion script, independent of the dashboard server: config via env (PROMETHEUS_URL default http://localhost:9090, ALERT_WEBHOOK, ANOMALY_THRESHOLD default 1.20, BASELINE_WINDOW 24h, CHECK_WINDOW 1h, LOG_FILE default /var/log/cfn/cost-anomaly-detection.log); queries Prometheus with curl+jq.
- `monitoring/cost-anomaly-detection.sh:87`: detect_anomalies() iterates teams from label_values(zai_api_cost_usd, team), compares the last-1h rate against the same window offset 24h, and when ratio > threshold calls send_alert() (webhook POST + pushgateway gauges at localhost:9091); teams without baseline data are skipped, not alerted. main() dispatches modes detect (default) / health (Prometheus /-/healthy plus metric count) / test (threshold lowered to 1.10).
